label: Title
definition: The name of the resource, in plain English.

label: Description
definition: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

label: Identifier
definition: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

label: Publisher
definition: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

label: Contact point
definition: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

label: Access rights
definition: Who can get the data, and on what terms.

label: Security classification
definition: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

label: Licence
definition: The licence under which the resource can be used.

label: Update frequency
definition: How often the resource is updated.

label: Critical data asset
definition: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.

label: Creator
definition: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.

label: Created
definition: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.

label: Conforms to
definition: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

label: Time period covered
definition: The period of time the data is about.

label: Personal data
definition: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.

label: Rights statement
definition: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.

label: Last updated
definition: The date the content of the resource last changed.

label: Release date
definition: The date the resource was first made available.

label: Summary
definition: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.

label: Theme
definition: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.

label: Keyword
definition: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.

label: Geographic coverage
definition: The geographic area the data is about.

label: Distribution
definition: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.

label: Landing page
definition: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.

label: Version
definition: The version of the resource.

label: Sensitive data
definition: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.

label: Responsible role
definition: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.

label: Language
definition: The language or languages of the resource.

label: Alternative title
definition: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.

label: Other identifier
definition: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.

label: Part of series
definition: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

label: Replaced by
definition: A newer resource that replaces this one.

label: Expires
definition: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.

label: Previous version
definition: The version this one replaces in a sequence.

label: Version notes
definition: What changed in this version.

label: Spatial resolution (metres)
definition: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.

label: Time resolution
definition: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.

label: Reference data used
definition: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.

label: Data quality
definition: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.

label: Related resource
definition: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

label: Qualified relation
definition: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.

label: Documentation
definition: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.

label: Who can see this record
definition: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

label: Applicable legislation
definition: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.

label: Usage policy
definition: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.

label: Where the data is held or sent
definition: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.

label: Transfer safeguard
definition: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.

label: Missing value
definition: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.
